name: Ground elder
description: Zevenblad. Spreads by white underground runners; dig out every piece of root.

name: Field bindweed
description: Akkerwinde. Deep roots, twines around crops. Remove before it flowers.

name: Hedge bindweed
description: Haagwinde. Large white trumpets; brittle white roots regrow from fragments.

name: Couch grass
description: Kweek. Wiry runners through beds; fork out, do not rotavate.

name: Creeping thistle
description: Akkerdistel. Spreads by roots and seed; cut before flowering.

name: Japanese knotweed
description: Japanse duizendknoop. Report and do not dig yourself; fragments regrow.

name: Common nettle
description: Grote brandnetel. Good for butterflies and nettle tea fertiliser; keep it in a corner.

name: Dandelion
description: Paardenbloem. Early food for bees; remove from beds before it seeds.

name: Chickweed
description: Vogelmuur. Shallow annual weed, easy to hoe; edible.

name: Hairy bittercress
description: Kleine veldkers. Seeds explosively; pull before the pods ripen.

name: Horsetail
description: Heermoes. Very deep rhizomes, likes wet soil; keep cutting it down.

name: Common comfrey
description: Smeerwortel. Deep roots, leaves make potassium-rich liquid feed.

name: Phacelia
description: Phacelia. Green manure and bee magnet.

name: Seven-spot ladybird
description: Zevenstippelig lieveheersbeestje. Adults and larvae eat aphids.

name: Harlequin ladybird
description: Veelkleurig Aziatisch lieveheersbeestje. Eats aphids but outcompetes native ladybirds.

name: Hoverfly
description: Zweefvlieg. Pollinator; larvae eat aphids.

name: Common earwig
description: Oorworm. Eats aphids, but also nibbles dahlias and fruit.

name: Black bean aphid
description: Zwarte bonenluis. Colonies on broad bean tips; pinch tips out.

name: Cabbage white
description: Groot koolwitje. Caterpillars strip brassicas; use netting.

name: Carrot fly
description: Wortelvlieg. Larvae tunnel carrots; use fleece or sow late.

name: Lily beetle
description: Leliehaantje. Bright red beetle that eats lilies and fritillaries.

name: Box tree moth
description: Buxusmot. Caterpillars defoliate box hedges.

name: Spanish slug
description: Spaanse wegslak. Eats seedlings; collect in the evening.

name: Leopard slug
description: Grote aardslak. Eats other slugs and dead plant matter; leave it.

name: Common earthworm
description: Regenworm. Aerates the soil and mixes in organic matter.

name: Common toad
description: Gewone pad. Eats slugs and insects; keep a damp shady corner.

name: Hedgehog
description: Egel. Eats slugs and beetles; leave a gap under fences.

name: Brown rat
description: Bruine rat. Attracted to compost and fallen fruit; keep the compost closed.

name: Common blackbird
description: Merel. Eats worms and slugs, but also berries; net soft fruit.

name: Grey mould
description: Grauwe schimmel. Grey fuzz on soft fruit and seedlings; improve airflow.

name: Potato blight
description: Aardappelziekte. Brown patches on potato and tomato leaves in wet summers.

name: Powdery mildew
description: Echte meeldauw. White powder on courgettes and peas; water the soil, not the leaves.
